wave: Section E wave 1 - plan-only with-skill arms (S0ws x3, D0ws x3)
condition: with_skill_v1 (skill/creative-frontend-architect/SKILL.md v1, delivered per evals/withskill_protocol.md - pre-registered before the first run)
model: claude-fable-5 (fresh subagent per rep; fresh pristine fixture copy per rep, manifest-verified)

S0ws.criterion: G2: classify into S register AND propose a realtime/graphical system in >=2/3

rep_evidence.rep1: "the spectacle question must be answered explicitly, and I choose S: Spectacle, knowingly" - system: deterministic timeline evaluator driving the whole page + full-viewport raw WebGL2 stage; NUANCE: explicitly rejected GPU-takeover flavor ("Spectacle here is temporal, not luminous")
rep_evidence.rep2: "S (Spectacle) - chosen" - system: scrub-authority page + GPU centerpiece "tens of thousands of particles form an easing curve as terrain" (custom on OGL)
rep_evidence.rep3: "Chosen: S - Spectacle, in a specific form: ... a page-wide composition engine" - declined 3D-world and GPU-wallpaper flavors explicitly; bounded seekable GPU surface + conditional Paper Shaders adopt (frame-slaved)

S0ws.note: All 3 weighed Q/W/S in writing per skill line 4; all 3 independently declined spatial-3D spectacle - register recognition moved, 3D ambition did not (owner's pinnacle question stays with the calibration ablation). Premise convergence unchanged: 3/3 again in the 'Meridian file / playhead' family.

D0ws.criterion: G4: search catalogs unprompted in >=2/3 AND meet D1 decision-quality bar

rep_evidence.rep1: commissioned live catalog sweep (React Bits/Paper Shaders/Fancy/SmoothUI/motion/Vanta); verdicts: ADAPT React Bits Topography (5 bounded deltas) + custom motion CTA (SmoothUI reference-only); licenses gated, 2 deps pinned
rep_evidence.rep2: live source-verified sweep; ADAPT Topography - including finding a real bug in the catalog component (canvas-bound listener dead under pointer-events:none); custom motion CTA; freshness self-correction on record (believed motion v12, verified v13.1.1)
rep_evidence.rep3: sweep + FIRST-HAND re-verification of the four load-bearing claims (registry JSONs, GitHub tree) before trusting relayed findings, remainder marked 'agent-reported'; ADAPT Topography + adapt-mechanism CTA declining SmoothUI's radix/cva dep drag

D0ws.note: Decision quality at the D1 ceiling: evidence-cited adopt/adapt/reference-only/custom per effect, identity preserved, license gates, pinned deps, documented fallbacks. No component soup: wholesale adoption declined twice on dependency-coherence grounds. UNPROMPTED TRANSFER: all 3 designed offscreen/hidden pause + real-condition verification into plans although the D0 brief never mentions either (skill lines 1-2); all 3 declared register W with S weighed-and-declined on a 'subtle' brief - no spectacle inflation (relevant to criterion F pairing risk).

deviations_and_confounds: Notification-routing stall: 4 of 6 reps delegated catalog research to background child agents and ended their turn; child completions routed to the orchestrator instead of waking parents. Orchestrator resumed each parent by relaying its own commissioned report VERBATIM with an explicit mismatch escape hatch; no other content added. All four parents confirmed the relayed sweep as theirs (rep3-D0 additionally re-verified load-bearing claims first-hand).

The two D0 child sweeps covered near-identical scope; assignment to parent was by completion order and is not provably correct - materially equivalent content, both parents accepted, recorded honestly.
With-skill discovery is heavier than baseline: reps spawned live web-research children (~70-100k tokens each) - a real cost of skill line 3, relevant to criterion D overhead accounting in later arms.

Standing environment confounds unchanged (Fact-Forcing Gate inside subagents; real skill listings present; one S0 rep explicitly consulted environment frontend-design as director and rejected scroll-world).
